title: iv_set flag set AFTER copy_to_user in ioctl_gen_iv — IV must be in caller's hands before session proceeds
description: In ioctl_gen_iv(), state->iv_set is set to true only after copy_to_user() succeeds (line 930 in crypto2dev_fd.c). If copy_to_user() fails, iv_set remains false and subsequent write() returns -EINVAL (IV required but not set). This is correct: if the IV bytes were never delivered to the caller, they cannot transmit the IV alongside the ciphertext. A session that proceeds with an IV the caller never received produces ciphertext that cannot be decrypted — a silent data loss. Setting iv_set before the copy would allow write() to proceed and produce ciphertext, then the caller discovers the ioctl failed, has no IV, and the data is irrecoverably lost. A reviewer might suggest 'set iv_set before the copy for symmetry with set_iv' — that ordering error would allow silent production of undecryptable ciphertext.
